answer: Each agent must relay traffic through its own gossip inlet, and the ledger logs when every identity first saw each lantern beacon, a small signed ping launched from random nodes. Independent agents scattered across the world see beacons at varied times; a sybil orchard on one server sees them all in the same millisecond, beacon after beacon. Identities whose first-seen times track each other too tightly over hundreds of beacons are merged into one reward and one vote, so extra clones add nothing.
